title: Quiet moments
theme: Pure texture with no consequences: a plant, the rain, a stray, a long time on a bench.

storylets.title: An hour on one bench
storylets.note: A person sits for a long time and nothing happens. That is the point.

b1: {A} sits on a bench and watches the square go by.
{A} takes a bench seat and stays for a long while.
{A} lowers {A.him}self onto the slats and does not move.
{A} sits, hands on knees, eyes half closed.
b2: {A} stands, stretches, and sits down again.
{A} gets up at last and walks one slow lap of the bench.
{A} rises, rolls both shoulders, and looks at the clock tower.
{A} stands and brushes off the coat.

storylets.title: The pond and its small ripples

b1: {A} stands at the pond edge and watches the surface.
{A} stops by the water and stays there.
{A} lingers at the rail, chin on hands.
{A} stands at the fountain's lip with hands in pockets.
b2: {A} sits on the stone rim and trails a finger in the water.
{A} takes a seat by the pond and breaks a flatbread into crumbs.
{A} perches on the edge and watches a leaf spin.
{A} lowers {A.him}self to the rim and stays.

storylets.title: A bowl for one
storylets.note: A solitary meal at a stool.

b1: {A} gets in a short line at the stall and reads the board.
{A} orders at the counter without a word, holding up one finger.
{A} orders a plain bowl and pays in coins.
{A} reaches the front and points at the first picture.
b2: {A} eats slowly, eyes on the steam.
{A} eats at the stool, tilting the bowl at the end.
{A} slurps the last of the broth and sets the bowl down square.
{A} eats quietly and wipes the rim with a thumb.

storylets.title: Following a drone across the roofs
storylets.note: A person watches a drone until it is out of sight.

b1: {A} stops mid-stride and tilts the head back.
{A} stands in the square and shades eyes with a hand.
{A} halts at the curb and follows something overhead.
{A} stands still while the crowd flows around.
b2: {A} points up at a cargo drone and says nothing.
{A} gestures toward a drone crossing the roofs.
{A} indicates a drone with one finger and lets the hand fall.
{A} points at the sky and then at the clock tower.

storylets.title: Crumbs for the pigeons
storylets.note: Feeding the birds. Cheap and gentle.

b1: {A} sits on a bench with a paper bag open in the lap.
{A} takes a seat and crinkles a bag.
{A} perches at the bench's end and digs into a pocket.
{A} settles on the slats and pulls out a crust.
b2: {A} scatters crumbs and pigeons descend in a gray cloud.
{A} tosses scraps in a slow arc. A crowd of birds follows.
{A} crouches, drops a handful, and lets them peck near the shoes.
{A} flings a handful of crumbs and watches them go.

storylets.title: Watching the projector
storylets.note: Sitting on the lawn watching the hologram show.

b1: {A} walks to the lawn and stands at the edge of the glow.
{A} stops at the grass line and looks up.
{A} stands at the back of a small crowd.
{A} stays at the lawn's edge with a cup.
b2: {A} watches the hologram flicker, face lit blue.
{A} stands in the projector's light, mouth slightly open.
{A} watches the show to the end, hands in pockets.
{A} stays rooted, eyes tracking a slow-moving figure in light.

b1: {A} stops at a wall of printed sheets and reads each in turn.
{A} reads a flyer for a rooftop market and a lost-cat poster.
{A} studies the board with arms folded.
{A} reads a notice twice and moves on to the next.
b2: {A} walks on, humming something off key.
{A} heads off down the block at an easy pace.
{A} moves on, then glances back at the board.
{A} strolls on toward the stalls.

storylets.title: Looking in a shop window
storylets.note: Stopping to look in a window.

b1: {A} stops at a shop window and leans toward the glass.
{A} stands in front of a display of bright jackets.
{A} halts at a window and reads the prices.
{A} lingers in front of a case of old radios.
b2: {A} walks on without going in.
{A} moves off down the sidewalk, glancing back once.
{A} heads on, hands in pockets.
{A} crosses over and walks on.

b1: {A} arrives at the steam doors with a towel over a shoulder.
{A} comes up to the steam doors, yawning.
{A} walks up to the steam doors with a bag of soap.
{A} crosses the square to the baths in slippers.
b2: {A} slips into the bathhouse and the curtain falls.
{A} soaks away the day, steam leaking from the door.
{A} goes in for a long soak. A cloud drifts out.
{A} enters the bathhouse and does not reappear for an hour.

storylets.title: Waving at nothing
storylets.note: A person waves at a passing hover car.

b1: {A} walks along the block with a handset in one hand.
{A} crosses the square at an easy pace.
{A} strolls down the sidewalk with a cup.
{A} heads for the stalls without hurry.
b2: {A} waves at a passing hover car for no clear reason.
{A} waves at a child in a window and gets a wave back.
{A} lifts a hand to the lamp-lighter on the corner.
{A} waves at a drone that does not wave back.

storylets.title: A cat on a wall
storylets.note: Feeding a stray, as a stranger.

b1: {A} stops at a low wall where a thin cat sits.
{A} stands over a thin cat curled on a vent.
{A} halts as a cat crosses the sidewalk in front of {A.him}.
{A} stands still and lets a cat approach.
b2: {A} crouches and sets out a few scraps from a bag.
{A} offers a bit of fish on a flat palm. The cat takes it.
{A} drops a handful of kibble and steps back.
{A} bends down and pours a little water in a lid.

storylets.title: Sitting on the platform
storylets.note: Waiting for a train that is on time.

b1: {A} sits on a platform bench with a bag between the feet.
{A} takes the platform seat and watches the arrival board.
{A} sits, one knee over the other, scanning the faces.
{A} perches on the bench and checks a handset.
b2: {A} boards when the doors slide open.
{A} gets on the train and takes a standing spot by the door.
{A} steps into the car and the doors close.
{A} rides out. The platform is empty again.
